name: Zantetsuken (Odin)
doc: Zantetsuken (the monster Odin's attack, c0m070): sparks off the caster's sword as it swings, the blade's trail, two screen models, the stage shown and a screen fade, the caster moved away, every target cut in two along a tilted plane and one half sliding off, fading; the sound; the damage at tick 143. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag167_zantetsuken.cpp) run on the program's memory (its spark pool, splines, trail history and queues in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.
